end.summary:
- Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
- Discussed cylinder features: two round faces and one curved side.
- Recognised a cylinder when its position changed.
- Used a gas cylinder and chakla belan as examples.
- Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised identifying 3D shapes, especially the cylinder, by noticing its two round faces and curved side. They correctly explained that a cylinder remains the same shape when it is standing or lying down. The lesson included a repeated request to see a plate picture, but the picture was not shown; this was clarified when Ishita checked their own plate. At home, ask them to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, and sphere and name each shape’s visible features.
